records.rationale: Original five-file implementation truncated the file VMA and recursively overlaid its tail with a private MAP_FIXED anonymous VMA. f24ebb94679f explicitly removes the helpers, their do_mmap calls and alternate alignment macro. The original mm_inline include is also absent in final ACK/port, replaced by later independent includes. Do not resurrect mapping-time fixed remapping, stale EOF decisions or lost sharing semantics. Existing emulation flags predated this commit and later retired separately; not every page-size facility is removed. These are positive retirement decisions, not a finding that 16 KiB emulation lacks consumers. No new code or runtime verification.

Original three-file revision keeps the full initial file mapping and limits its private anonymous overlay to the remaining emulated-page tail, correcting SIGBUS boundaries in the old design. 13fa503273ef restores both helper function bodies exactly to pre-revision form; f24ebb94679f then removes the entire design. Preserve that explicit retirement. Its intent is not proof that the newer shared-tail design is safe or fully implemented. These are positive retirement decisions, not a finding that 16 KiB emulation lacks consumers. No new code or runtime verification.

Read the full meaningful inverse changes and checked both helper bodies against e35913a77139 parent. This revert temporarily restores the older length-shrinking/remap algorithm; the following f24ebb94679f removes both helpers and callsites. No reason to recreate that intermediate algorithm in the LTS port. These are positive retirement decisions, not a finding that 16 KiB emulation lacks consumers. No new code or runtime verification.

Retain explicit removal of mapping-time file-length shrinking, recursive anonymous MAP_FIXED tail replacement, helper declarations and __COMPAT_PAGE_ALIGN. Current do_mmap has no retired calls and retains native overflow and mapping checks with the separately audited __PAGE_ALIGN emulation. The replacement fault-time b3c77090341c candidate remains provisional because its shared-tail behavior still needs safe resolution. These are positive retirement decisions, not a finding that 16 KiB emulation lacks consumers. No new code or runtime verification.
